title: Triage order for any report
symptoms: Any "it crashes" / "it doesn't work" message
cause: Most reports so far were data-side (incomplete copy, skipped GTAV_patch, missing movies) or an old build, not new code bugs.
player_fix: Ask for the whole Logs folder: iPhone/iPad Files > On My iPhone > GTA V > Logs (run.log, run.prev.log, crash-*.txt); Mac ~/Library/Logs/GTA5. Also the device, the iOS version and what they were doing.
Find the build: the first log line / the report's device line has "GTA5 UUID ..., compat built ...". Match it in REF-02. Anyone not on the 26 Oct 2026 (batches 87-91) release should update first.
Check the data: the launcher's DATA tab should show the full set (113 archives, about 21.6 GB). Any "Unable to find critical archive" line = incomplete copy (DATA-02).
Check the fix patch: a run.log line "datapatch: no patches and no .macport_decrypted marker" means GTAV_patch was never applied (DATA-03).
Check movies: "no movies/<name>.mp4" lines mean movies.zip is missing (DATA-05).
Then match the crash text against the log signatures in this knowledge base.
reply: Please send the whole Logs folder (Files > On My iPhone > GTA V > Logs), your device and iOS version, and what you were doing when it happened.

title: Reading a crash or hang report
symptoms: Player sends crash-*.txt or run.log and asks what it means
log_signatures: fault: read from 0x...: a null pointer + 0x...
--- the game, at most a second before ---
cause: Reports name the signal, the fault decoded (null pointer + offset, freed memory = use-after-free), rage's fatal message, memory/thermal state, the device line, the game state of the last second (player, position, vehicle, cutscene, running scripts = which mission) and the log's tail.
player_fix: "fatal error:" lines and "Unable to find critical archive" are the most telling: start there.
SIGTRAP (__debugbreak) right after "Unable to find critical archive" = missing data file (DATA-02).

"Game hung for 10 s" = hang report; after 60 s the hang detector deliberately crashes the game (a write to 0 from "[RAGE] Hang Detect Thread"). Look for a "streamer: ... stalled" line first (DATA-03).
"terminated by signal 15" = the app was closed (by the player or the system), not a crash.

run.prev.log starting with "[macport] previous run: ... no report" = iOS ended the app without a crash (memory limit, swiped away, or killed in the background). Check the last memory line ("MB left").
A fault at 0xdddddddddddddddd + small offset = a use-after-free in the original game code (CRASH-02).
The running-scripts list tells the mission (e.g. trevor3 = Friends Reunited, docks_heista = The Merryweather Heist, fbi3 = By the Book, gunclub_shop = Ammu-Nation).
fixed_in: Rich reports since batch 66 (20 Oct release)
sources: HANDOFF: Logs and crash reports with more in them

title: "Can't find its game data" / No titles found / launcher says Not found
symptoms: The app says it has no game data
"Scan Complete! No titles were found"
Launcher DATA tab: GAME DATA "Not found"
I copied the files but the game doesn't see them
I can't find "GTA V" under On My iPhone
log_signatures: Grand Theft Auto V can't find its game data.
Scan Complete! No titles were found
cause: The game data folder has the wrong name (GTAV_IOS, gtav, GTAV (1)), sits in the wrong place (iCloud Drive, Downloads, loose in On My iPhone), or is nested (GTAV > GTAV_IOS > common.rpf). The app only looks for On My iPhone > GTA V > GTAV with common.rpf directly inside.
player_fix: Open the app once so iOS creates its "GTA V" folder in Files (Browse > On My iPhone).
Unzip the game files completely; inside the result, find the folder that has common.rpf directly in it.
Rename that folder to exactly GTAV (capitals, no spaces, no _IOS).
Move it into On My iPhone > GTA V (on iPad: On My iPad > GTA V).
Test: open On My iPhone > GTA V > GTAV. You must see common.rpf right there.
Restart the app; the DATA tab should say "Ready" (or "Decrypts on first start" with GTAV_patch).
reply: The folder has to be On My iPhone > GTA V > GTAV, named exactly GTAV, with common.rpf directly inside. Rename GTAV_IOS to GTAV and move it there, then restart the app.
sources: session: game file install tutorial (17 Oct)

title: Crash 2-7 seconds after Play: a game archive is missing (incomplete data copy)
symptoms: Crashes right after pressing Play, every time
Crashes on the first loading screen
The launcher says Ready but the game closes after a few seconds
My DATA tab shows fewer archives / fewer GB than other people's
log_signatures: Unable to find critical archive 'x64a.rpf', check that RFS connected properly.
devices: Seen on iPhone 11 Pro (iOS 18.2), iPad 10th gen (A14, 4 GB, iOS 27.2), iPhone 15 Pro Max, a 16 Oct sideload; any device can hit it
cause: The copy or unzip stopped part way (no space, phone locked, cable unplugged), or files were deleted to save space. The game stops at the first missing archive, so more may be missing. The launcher's scan only checks that common.rpf exists and counts archives, so it can still say Ready.
player_fix: Copy the whole GTAV folder again (keep the phone plugged in, Auto-Lock off, enough free space).
A full set has 113 archives, about 21.6 GB; x64a.rpf to x64w.rpf are 23 files and GTAV/x64/audio/sfx holds about 54 .rpf files.
Folder and file names must match exactly (lowercase as shipped): there is no case-insensitive fallback.
If the data is new on this device, apply GTAV_patch once afterwards (DATA-03) and set up movies (DATA-05).
notes: Open improvement: a launcher check against the full list (113 archives and sizes) with a plain "x64k.rpf is missing" message was proposed, not built.
reply: Your game data is incomplete: the log says [file] is missing. Delete the GTAV folder and copy it again completely (113 archives, about 21.6 GB), with the phone plugged in and Auto-Lock off.

title: Paleto Bay freeze / crash, Friends Reunited (trevor3) crash, endless loading after Trevor's missions: GTAV_patch not applied
symptoms: The game freezes near Paleto Bay (by the barber shop, driving through town)
Crash while driving around Paleto Bay
Crash when Trevor gets near his trailer in Sandy Shores / when Friends Reunited starts
"Trevor missions broke everything": endless loading screens on death and in menus, missions don't start
Endless loading after respawning at Paleto Bay hospital
Crash at the towing jobs (Tonya)
log_signatures: stalled (deflate): ... rest of its output zeroed
SIGSEGV in strcasecmp from scrProgram::scrProgram on ResourcePlacementThread
datapatch: no patches and no .macport_decrypted marker
devices: Any. Reported on iPhone 13 Pro, iPhone 16 (iOS 26.7.1), iPhone 14 Pro Max (iOS 27.0), iPad Pro M4 (iOS 27.2 beta), and others; still being reported on 27 Oct
cause: Five scripts in update/update2.rpf were left encrypted by the data conversion tool (Rescue Hostage random event re_rescuehostage, the story mission Friends Reunited trevor3, towing, and two Online scripts). Before the 18 Oct build the game froze for good when one loaded; since 18 Oct the stall guard writes a report and zeroes the file, and the game then crashes about a second later on the empty script. It's game data, so a new IPA alone doesn't fix it.
player_fix: Get the GTAV_patch folder from the 22 Oct download.
Copy it into On My iPhone > GTA V, NEXT TO the GTAV folder (not inside it). Don't rename it.
Start the game once: it shows "Preparing the game data", applies the fix and deletes the folder.
If the app then says the data doesn't match its patches, see DATA-04.
Existing saves are fine; once the data is fixed, Friends Reunited and Paleto Bay load normally.
fixed_in: Data: GTAV_patch (phone-format fix, 18 Oct; in the 22 Oct download). Code: batch 60 stall guard (18 Oct release) turns the freeze into a named report.
notes: Still the most common report (at least five players so far). Proposed, not built: ship the fix inside the IPA and apply it automatically by script name, so any data copy is fixed without a patch folder.
reply: That's the Paleto Bay / Friends Reunited script issue: your game data is missing the fix patch. Copy the GTAV_patch folder from the 22 Oct download into On My iPhone > GTA V, next to the GTAV folder (not inside), and start the game once. It applies itself. If it says update2.rpf is missing or a different size, tell us and we'll send you a fixed file.
sources: sessions of 25 Oct and 27 Oct (two more unpatched players)

title: "The game data doesn't match its decryption patches" / app won't start after copying GTAV_patch
symptoms: After copying GTAV_patch the app refuses to start
Error screen about the game data not matching its patches
The patch step fails every start
log_signatures: datapatch: .../GTAV/update/update2.rpf: missing or a different size than the patch expects
bytes at 0x... don't match the patch source
The game data doesn't match its decryption patches
cause: The fix patch changes bytes at fixed positions and only fits one exact update2.rpf: the 16 Oct phone data (277,832,704 bytes, 277.8 MB in Files). Causes seen: the player's data is another conversion (different size); the very first 18 Oct package briefly shipped the fix for the PC-format file (325,668,864 bytes); the folder got nested (GTAV_patch/GTAV_patch/...) or put inside GTAV; extra "._" files from a USB stick or a Finder zip ("not a patch"). While a GTAV_patch folder fails, the app refuses to start so it can't damage the archive.
player_fix: To play again right away: delete the GTAV_patch folder (the game starts as before, without the Paleto/trevor3 fix).
Check the size: Files > On My iPhone > GTA V > GTAV > update > long-press update2.rpf > Get Info.
277.8 MB: use the GTAV_patch from the 22 Oct download (the phone-format fix); the layout must be exactly GTA V/GTAV_patch/update/update2.rpf.rpfpatch.
Any other size: the data is a different copy. Replace GTAV/update/update2.rpf with an already-patched 277,832,704-byte update2.rpf from the maintainer (tap Replace). This fixed a player on 21 Oct.
Leaving GTAV_patch in place next to an already-fixed update2.rpf is harmless: it finds the fix in place and removes itself.
fixed_in: 18 Oct evening: release package switched to the phone-format fix
notes: Proposed, not built: show the file size on the error screen, skip a patch that doesn't fit, ignore ._ files.
reply: Your update2.rpf isn't the version the patch was made for. Delete the GTAV_patch folder to play again, then tell us the size of GTAV/update/update2.rpf (Files > long-press > Get Info). If it isn't 277.8 MB we'll send you an already-fixed update2.rpf to replace yours.

title: App stopped opening after about a week
symptoms: The game won't open anymore
It worked yesterday, now it closes immediately
App icon greyed out / "no longer available"
devices: Any device signed with a free Apple ID
cause: Apps signed with a free Apple ID stop opening after 7 days when the provisioning profile expires.
player_fix: Refresh or re-sign the app with the same signing app you used (AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, LiveContainer, ...), installed over the top.
Don't delete the app first: the game files and saves live inside it (SIGN-02).
reply: Free Apple ID signatures expire after 7 days. Refresh or re-sign the app with the same signing app, installing over the top. Don't delete it first, or the game files and saves go with it.

title: After updating, the game data or saves are gone
symptoms: After installing the update it asks for the game data again
My saves disappeared
There are two GTA V apps now
log_signatures: Grand Theft Auto V can't find its game data.
cause: The game files (about 22 GB) and saves live inside the app's own container. Deleting the app deletes them; installing the update as a second copy (different bundle ID or another signing app) gives an empty new app.
player_fix: Install every update OVER the old app with the same signing app and the same bundle ID.
If it was already deleted, copy the GTAV folder again (DATA-01), then GTAV_patch and movies once.
Back up saves from Files > On My iPhone > GTA V > Rockstar Games > GTA V; the launcher's DATA > IMPORT SAVE (22 Oct release and newer) brings a save file back into a slot.
reply: The game files and saves live inside the app. Always install updates over the old app with the same signing app; deleting it or installing a second copy starts empty.

title: Out-of-memory closes on 6-8 GB phones: the signer dropped the increased memory limit
symptoms: The game closes without a crash report after driving a long way or switching characters
RAM drops below 1 GB in the FPS panel, then it closes
Crashes on an iPhone 17 Pro / 8 GB phone with high texture settings
The launcher says iOS lets the game use only about 3.3 GB on an 8 GB phone
log_signatures: [macport] memory: iOS lets the game use N MB
devices: Seen on an iPhone 17 Pro and an 8 GB iPhone 16 (about 3.4 GB available); a 6 GB iPhone 13 Pro report without logs
cause: iOS ends the app at its memory limit, which depends on the signature, not the RAM. The IPA asks for the increased-memory-limit entitlement, but free-account signers keep it only when the App ID has that capability (what GetMoreRam turns on). Without it an 8 GB phone gives the game ~3.3 GB. Before the 21 Oct release the 12 GB preset's 1600 MB texture cache didn't fit such limits.
player_fix: Update to the 21 Oct release or newer: presets and the game's budgets follow the app's real memory limit.
Use a signing method that keeps the increased-memory-limit entitlement (e.g. enable the capability with GetMoreRam for a free account). Nothing inside the app can raise the limit.
Pick a lower preset or a smaller Texture Cache / Streaming Memory in the launcher.
If it still closes, send run.prev.log: its first lines tell how the previous run ended and its last memory line.
fixed_in: Budgets by the app's limit: batch 69, 21 Oct release
notes: A 13 Pro player's RAM write-up (garbage collector, swap, etc.) was reviewed on 21 Oct: mostly not applicable to iOS; logs were asked for and never analysed.
reply: Your signing method gives the game less memory than your phone has. Update to the latest build (its presets follow the real limit) and, if you can, sign with the increased memory limit kept (GetMoreRam for free accounts). Lower Texture Cache if it still closes.

title: Instant crash at launch on iOS 18 / iOS 26 (old 16 Oct IPA)
symptoms: Crashes instantly when I open it / press Play
Closes before anything shows
log_signatures: Failed to create internal command library
devices: iPhone 16 Pro Max (iOS 18.3 and iOS 26.2.1); also seen inside LiveContainer
cause: The graphics layer's built-in Metal library in the 16 Oct IPAs was built for iOS 27 only, so older iOS refused it at device creation.
player_fix: Install any IPA from 17 Oct or later (the current release).
fixed_in: 16 Oct evening rebuild; every IPA since 17 Oct

title: iOS 16: the game doesn't work (crash ~7 s after Play, or endless loading with nothing drawn)
symptoms: Crashes a few seconds after Play on iOS 16
Stuck loading for minutes, phone gets hot
Nothing renders
log_signatures: Failed to create MTLLibrary: ... This library format is not supported on this platform
SIGSEGV in DXMT pipeline-cache worker threads (compat thread ids 352/356)
devices: iPhone 13 on iOS 16.6.1 (the only iOS 16 report)
cause: iOS 16's GPU shader compiler refuses every pipeline the graphics layer (DXMT) builds. The same shaders compile on newer iOS. The iOS 16 effort was dropped as not worth it.
player_fix: Update iOS: every device that can run the game (A13 and newer) can run iOS 17 or later; iOS 18+ is confirmed working.
notes: The IPA still says minimum iOS 16.3, so it installs on iOS 16 but can't run. No iOS 17 report yet.
reply: iOS 16 isn't supported: its graphics compiler rejects the game's shaders. Update to iOS 18 or newer.

title: Which devices run the game?
symptoms: Will it run on my iPhone/iPad?
Is iPhone 11 / XR / iPad X supported?
os_versions: iOS 18+ confirmed; iOS 16 doesn't work; iOS 17 untested
cause: The graphics path needs Apple GPU family features; RAM decides the settings.
player_fix: Confirmed working (6 GB+): iPhone 12 Pro Max, 13 Pro, 14, 14 Pro, 14 Pro Max, 15, 15 Pro Max, 16, 16 Pro Max, 17 Pro Max; iPad Pro M4, A16 iPad.
A13 (iPhone 11 series): an iPhone 11 was verified running it (21 Oct).
4 GB devices (iPhone 12/12 mini, iPhone 13/13 mini, iPad 10th gen, iPhone 11): run at the lowest preset (Battery Saver); iOS gives a 4 GB iPad about 2.9 GB. See DEV-04.

A12 / A12X / A12Z (iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, iPad Pro 2018/2020): experimental path since the 24 Oct evening test build, in every release since 25 Oct. An A12Z iPad Pro ran it with no visual glitches; no XS/XR has reported. The XR's 3 GB is probably too little.
Not supported: A11 and older; iOS 16.
Mac: Apple silicon (M1 or later), macOS 14 Sonoma or later (Mac app since 25 Oct).

title: 4 GB devices: crashes, closes, or stuck screens at higher settings
symptoms: Keeps closing on my iPhone 12 / iPhone 13 / iPad 10th gen
Out of memory on a 4 GB device
Black screen in a mission on a 4 GB phone
log_signatures: [macport] memory: iOS lets the game use 2867 MB
[macport] load scene ... not loaded after N s
cause: iOS lets a 4 GB device's game use roughly 2.3-2.9 GB. The low-memory budgets keep the game around 1.9 GB, but tight streaming budgets also starved some scripted scenes (garages, the Merryweather freighter), fixed in later builds.
player_fix: Start with the lowest preset (Battery Saver) and keep Texture Quality Normal.
Keep MSAA and Reflection MSAA Off (CRASH-05).
Update to the latest build: the garage and Merryweather stalls on small budgets are fixed (FREEZE-01, FREEZE-02).
fixed_in: Low-memory profile since the first shared builds; budgets by limit batch 69 (21 Oct)
reply: On 4 GB devices start with the Battery Saver preset, Normal textures and MSAA/Reflection MSAA Off, and make sure you're on the latest build.

title: A12Z iPad Pro: random crashes during play
symptoms: Random crashes every so often on an iPad Pro 2020
Crash while driving or flying
devices: iPad Pro 11" 2nd gen (A12Z) on the A12 test build
cause: A physics race: on Apple CPUs a lock's release doesn't order a later read the way the consoles' did, so a collision task could read a pair list before its count was settled and trip a bounds check.
player_fix: Update to the 25 Oct release or newer.
fixed_in: Batch 82 (24 Oct evening test build, 25 Oct release)
notes: One 10 s hang flying the Lazer on that iPad (render thread waiting, DXMT in IOGPUResourceCreate for an occlusion-query buffer) was not acted on: single sample, still open.
reply: That physics crash is fixed in the 25 Oct build and newer. Please update.

title: Crash about 25 s after loading a save: Reflection MSAA (or MSAA) set to 8x
symptoms: Crashes every time right after the save loads
Crash after changing graphics settings
Crashes when loading into the world, memory is fine
devices: iPhone 12 (A14, 4 GB) on the 24 Oct build; any Apple GPU (Mac too)
cause: Apple GPUs support at most 4x MSAA. The launcher and the in-game menu offered 8x up to the 26 Oct release; the game builds the water reflection targets with 8 samples, the graphics layer refuses, and the game uses the missing texture.
player_fix: Launcher > Graphics: set Reflection MSAA to Off (best on 4 GB devices), 2x or 4x.
Keep MSAA below 8x too (launcher Display page). Never pick 8x in the pause menu's Graphics page: it still offers it.
From the 27 Oct launcher update on, the launcher only offers Off / 2x / 4x, and a saved 8x shows as 4x and is written as 4x when you press Play.
Mac app (no launcher): keep both below 8x in the pause menu.
Main-frame MSAA isn't recommended at all: two of its shaders don't build on Apple GPUs (see notes). Use FXAA or Temporal AA instead.
fixed_in: Launcher only (compat launcher.mm, 27 Oct test IPA GTAV-unsigned.msaa-launcher-20261027.ipa); the game and its pause menu are unchanged by the maintainer's choice
status: launcher limit in a test build (not released); workaround
notes: 27 Oct Mac checks: the 26 Oct build with Reflection MSAA 8x crashed 12.6 s in exactly like the tester ("sample count 8 is not supported", then CreateFromTextureObject reading 0x0); Reflection MSAA 4x ran 2 min in the world (47 FPS). Main MSAA 2x with the 26 Oct Mac graphics layer ran 2 min without a crash, but two MSAA pixel shaders fail to build on the M1 ("Undefined symbols: llvm.agx2.sample.itrproj.1xf") and their draws are skipped; with the older 15 Oct Mac graphics layer MSAA 4x crashed in drawPrimitives on the dxmt-encode thread. A game-side cap was built and dropped (maintainer: launcher only).
reply: Your Reflection MSAA is set to 8x, which Apple GPUs can't do. In the launcher go to Graphics and set Reflection MSAA to Off, 2x or 4x (and keep MSAA below 8x; Off is best). Don't pick 8x in the pause menu.

title: Stuck at the door of a bought garage (Vinewood, Grove Street, Pillbox Hill)
symptoms: Soft lock when entering my garage

symptoms: Infinite loading / black screen after Franklin detonates the bombs and the ship starts exploding
The mission stops there and the story can't continue
Frozen camera on the sinking ship

notes: Confirmed on the developer's iPhone 13 Pro and on a player's 4 GB phone.

title: Game freezes on a phone call, a timer/alarm (Dynamic Island), Siri, or when Spotify plays
symptoms: Game freezes when a timer goes off
Freezes when I get a call
I can't play Spotify with the game
Game stuck after Siri
log_signatures: [macport] audio: output stopped (nothing taken for N ms): mixing on the clock
cause: The game's update waited on the audio engine, which waited on iOS's audio callback. An interruption stopped the audio output and nothing restarted it, so the whole game stopped.
player_fix: Update to the 25 Oct release or newer: the game keeps running and the sound restarts by itself.
Launcher > Audio > Music From Other Apps: Mix (default, Spotify plays along) or Stop It.
reply: Fixed in the 25 Oct build and newer; other apps' music can now play along (launcher > Audio).

title: Stick minigames can't be done on touch: By the Book (tooth), Did Somebody Say Yoga?, Reuniting the Family (tattoo)
symptoms: Can't pull the tooth in By the Book: it says rotate the right stick
The yoga poses are impossible on touch
Stuck at the tattoo in Reuniting the Family
Mission soft-locks because there's no right stick
cause: The camera area's right stick follows finger speed and drops to zero when the finger stops; these minigames need a held stick position. By the Book's pad text uses a token the prompt scan skipped until 26 Oct.
player_fix: Update to the 26 Oct release or newer.
By the Book: hold RT to grip, then the right stick appears under your left thumb; or tap Auto rotate.
Yoga: sticks hold their position; use the Auto pose toggle and the LT+RT button to breathe (21 Oct+).
Tattoo: the right side becomes a real right stick while the prompt shows (21 Oct+).
A controller also works.
fixed_in: Right-stick mode + yoga Auto pose: 21 Oct release (compat + batch 69); By the Book: batch 88, 26 Oct release
notes: By the Book confirmed on an iPhone 13 Pro; the yoga Auto pose and tattoo were only tested in the touch harness.
reply: Update to the 26 Oct build: By the Book puts the right stick under your left thumb (or tap Auto rotate) and the yoga has an Auto pose button.

On an older build: connect a controller to accept.
reply: Fixed in the 22 Oct build and newer (Darker, Brighter, Accept). Update, or use a controller on an old build.

title: Money is $0 after loading a save or after Wasted/Busted; shops refuse cheat money
symptoms: Money doesn't save
$0 after I die or get busted
Cheat says +$100,000 but the shop says I can't afford it
log_signatures: main takes SP1's stat N into its balance
cause: Story scripts only read the saved money back when an online profile is signed in; the port never has one, so every load zeroed the balance and money added by game code never reached it.
player_fix: Update to the 21 Oct release or newer. Existing saves get their money back on load (it was saved; only the balance was lost).
reply: Fixed since the 21 Oct build; loading your save restores the money that was saved.

title: Trainer interior teleports: places stay open or look odd afterwards
symptoms: After teleporting into an interior a building looks wrong / doubled
A closed place stays open
Loaded a save made inside an interior and something is off
cause: 28 of the 150 interiors are places story mode keeps closed; teleporting there unlocks them (and for 12 loads an optional map file, sometimes a building's mission version) until a story script resets it or the app is quit. Saves don't store this.
player_fix: Quit and relaunch the app to reset everything.
Don't save while standing inside a teleported-to interior.
Teleporting during a mission can fail the mission, like any teleport; using none of this changes nothing.
notes: Closing a place again on leaving was offered, not built. Playing a story mission after a teleport is untested.
reply: Interior teleports can leave some places open until you quit the app. Relaunch to reset, and don't save inside one.

symptoms: How do I play online?
Social Club doesn't work
Where did the ONLINE tab go?
cause: The port is story mode only: there is no signed-in Social Club profile, and Online can't work.
player_fix: Story mode only. The ONLINE, FRIENDS and STORE pause-menu tabs were removed in the 23 Oct release.

title: Exit Game goes back to the launcher instead of quitting
symptoms: Exit Game doesn't close the app
How do I restart the game?
cause: Since the 22 Oct release Exit Game returns to the launcher (CONTINUE / "Quit the game"). iOS doesn't let an app relaunch itself, so a fresh start needs a quit and a manual reopen.
player_fix: CONTINUE returns to the game; "Quit the game" closes it; then open the app again for a fresh start. Settings changed there apply at the next start.

title: No lock-on, can't snap to the next target while aiming
symptoms: No aim assist on touch
On a console holding LT and moving the stick snaps to the next target; here it doesn't
Aiming doesn't lock on
cause: The PC build's default Targeting Mode is Free Aim (consoles default to Assisted Aim). Free Aim has no lock-on, so there's nothing to switch between.
player_fix: Pause menu > Settings > Controls > Targeting Mode: Assisted Aim - Full (or Partial).
With lock-on, a quick sideways flick in the look area (about 450 pt/s) switches targets.
notes: An iOS default of Assisted Aim for new profiles was offered, not built.
reply: The PC default is Free Aim, which has no lock-on. Go to Settings > Controls > Targeting Mode and pick Assisted Aim; then a quick sideways flick switches targets.

symptoms: Wrong colours since the latest update
Blocky patches on surfaces
devices: Any chip other than the A15 (only the A15 was tested)

player_fix: Send a screenshot, the device model and the Logs folder.

title: Stuck at 30 or 60 FPS; 90/120/40 FPS options missing
symptoms: Capped at 30 FPS
Frame Limiter Off is still 60 FPS
No 120 FPS option
Where is 40 FPS?
cause: Old defaults Windowed + VSync Half capped the game at 30 FPS (switched once to Fullscreen/VSync Off in the 18 Oct release). Frame Limiter Off ran at 60 on ProMotion screens until 21 Oct. 90/120 FPS steps came on 22 Oct (VSync must be Off), 40 FPS on 26 Oct.
player_fix: Update to the latest build.
Launcher: Screen Type Fullscreen, VSync Off, then pick the Frame Limiter step.
Steps above the screen's refresh rate are hidden (144 never shows on iPhone/iPad).
If you go back to a build older than 26 Oct after choosing 40 FPS, the limiter reads Off.
fixed_in: 18 Oct (defaults), batch 69 21 Oct (Off), batch 71 22 Oct (90/120), batch 89 26 Oct (40)
reply: Set Fullscreen and VSync Off in the launcher, then choose the Frame Limiter step; 90/120 need a 120 Hz screen and the latest build.

title: 30 FPS isn't smooth / input lag
symptoms: 30 FPS shows 33.3 ms but still stutters
Controls feel laggy at 30 FPS
cause: Frames were handed to the screen with drifting timing (some held 50 ms). Input lag of ~100 ms at 30 FPS is the game's own frame pipeline.
player_fix: Update to the 23 Oct release or newer (presents wait for the screen).
For less lag, use a higher limit: 40 FPS on 120 Hz screens, or 60.
fixed_in: Frame pacing (DXMT present wait), 23 Oct release
reply: Frame pacing was fixed in the 23 Oct build. For less input lag, try 40 FPS (120 Hz screens) or 60.

title: FPS drops, phone gets hot
symptoms: FPS drops after the update
Phone gets very hot and FPS falls
60 FPS at first, then 40-50
cause: Heat, not the GPU's top speed, is the limit: an iPhone 13 Pro holds 60 FPS at thermal "fair" and drops to 40-50 at serious/critical. FPS-drop reports after the 20 Oct release found no cause in the code (Mac A/B identical).
player_fix: Use a 30 or 40 FPS cap (cooler and steadier).
Update to the 26 Oct release: GPU compression back on (about a sixth less GPU work per frame) and MetalFX capped at the screen's resolution.
Lower Frame Scaling / resolution or use a lower preset.
Send the Logs folder: run.log has FPS, slowest frames, memory and thermal state every 10 s.
reply: Heat is the main limit on phones. Use a 30 or 40 FPS cap and the 26 Oct build (less GPU work). If it still drops, send the Logs folder.

title: Mac: "macOS can't check the app" / GTA V was blocked
symptoms: The Mac app won't open the first time
macOS says the app is damaged or can't be verified
cause: The Mac app isn't notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks the first start.
player_fix: Right-click (Control-click) GTA V.app > Open > Open.
macOS 15 and later: open it once, then System Settings > Privacy & Security > "GTA V" was blocked > Open Anyway.
Or in Terminal: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/path/to/GTA V.app"
reply: Right-click GTA V.app > Open > Open (on macOS 15+: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway).

title: Mac: game data not found, TVs dark, patch step
symptoms: Mac app asks for the game folder
TVs are dark on the Mac
cause: The Mac app uses the same GTAV folder as the iPhone. A PC install's folder works but has no converted movies, so TVs stay dark.
player_fix: Put the GTAV folder beside the app or in Documents/GTAV; otherwise pick it at the first start.
If the phone data wasn't patched, put GTAV_patch beside GTAV before the first start (applied once).
For TVs, the GTAV folder needs the movies folder (DATA-05).
Logs: Finder > Go > Go to Folder > ~/Library/Logs/GTA5.
